nom: Benefit Cosmetics The POREfessional Good Cleanup Foaming Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the foaming gel as effective at cutting oil and residue without leaving a greasy after-feel, and helpful for shrinking the look of pores.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it does not strip or tighten their skin and even causes purging they welcome, while others report a tight or dry feeling and one says she can only use it as an occasional exfoliator because of dryness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances oil and hydration at once, with less clogging around the nose and fewer breakouts over time.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no irritation or breakouts and call it gentle enough for daily use, though one mentions an occasional brief burning sensation.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not dry out or strip the skin and leaves it feeling soft or hydrated; one reviewer with dry skin describes a tight feeling and limits use to mornings, and another with dry skin uses it only as an exfoliator.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports reduced redness around the chin and nose after about a week of use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers frequently describe the skin feeling clean without stripping or irritation, suggesting the barrier is not compromised for most users.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin describe reduced breakouts, smaller pimples overnight, and fading blackheads over weeks; one long-term user says results faded within two weeks of stopping, and one reviewer says it did nothing and made her skin worse.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer blemishes and improved texture with continued use, including reduced bumps and forehead texture; one three-year user says her pores remain clogged despite regular use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin say it removes excess oil and sunscreen effectively without leaving skin greasy afterward.

aspects.libelle: Small amount goes a long way

extraits.texte: In all of my years struggling with big pores and cystic acne this was a godsend for me! I have tried everything out there to help with my skin. I am 36 and since my late teen years, sadly I have never had clear skin. I tried this in a sample size that was suggested by a consultant working the makeup counter and it has absolutely changed my life. By the time I finished the sample size (about 2 months) my skin was clear. Even my family and friends noticed. I have been out for about two weeks and the acne has returned. I am ordering more ASAP! I will never go without this cleanser again!

extraits.titre: THE BEST & I'm picky about cleansers!
extraits.texte: My skin is super super sensitive and i struggle with trying new skincare because of that, especially with how expensive everything is these days. Ive been using this cleanser for almost a year now and it's the best thing that's ever touched my face. If you struggle with textrure or acne, this will make a significant difference. Whenever i get pimples and use this cleanser it reduces the size of them overnight. I always pair it with a spot treatment and a pimple patch to speed up the process. I never write reviews but this product deserved one. 10/10!!!

This is such a good cleanser if you don't want some thing to be so stripping but you want to feel clean. Still the fact that it's a foaming cleanser means that you won't really be able to use it with dry skin but with oily skin this is the perfect thing for you.
I can only use this as an exfoliator because I have dry skin but this has my skin purging so much and I love it!!!!
I have used it for 3 years and my pores are still so so clogged.. I continue to use it because it suds up nice and doesn't make me breakout but as far as cleaning pores out... I dont think it has

This is a citrus cleanser that is light and effective. It definitely gets rid of the appearance of my pores, however it also leaves my skin feeling a bit tight too so if you have dry skin I'd limit this one to morning use only. Gifted by benefit cosmetics

This cleanser is the best! After using for around 7days, my pores have shrunk, many blackheads went away, and some redness around my chin and nose area. I love the lemon-citrus scent and the packaging is adorable. But I truly love that this product worked for me since I have combination skin. Hydrates the skin!
